svg.title: Pignon — Pinus pinea / 松子
svg.desc: An opening, squat stone-pine cone with thick, spreading woody seed scales and dark spaces between them. A short twig carries long sage-green needles in distinct two-needle fascicles, each enclosed by a small brown basal sheath. Three elongated brown hard-shelled pine seeds and two smooth ivory edible kernels lie beside the cone. Fine curved engraving follows the woody shields, seed coats and cream kernels.
